title: Let an incremental task-sync import after a complete enrolment keep retained native notes under their own alias
outcome: Let an incremental task-sync import after a complete enrolment keep retained native notes under their own alias
acceptance: A host holding retained native notes under its own alias can enrol by completely importing a folder last written by another host, then incrementally import a commit touching a component with such a note, without a shared_identity refusal and without first exporting
A CLI regression covers enrolment followed by an incremental import on a host with retained native notes
